summary: GT Biopharma filed an 8-K covering routine charter housekeeping: elimination of eleven series of preferred stock via Certificates of Elimination (no shares outstanding before filing, except Series C converted), and a Certificate of Amendment for a reverse stock split and authorized-share reduction. These are standard capital-structure maintenance actions, not a special-situation event. No acquisition, tender, spin-off, restructuring, or strategic review is involved. The filing is purely administrative, with no deal terms, premium, or advisor. Watch for the effective date of the reverse split and any resulting Nasdaq compliance impact, but no risk-arb angle exists here.
